properties.description: Persistent URI identifying this proposition set (named graph).
Short human-readable label for this proposition set, e.g. naming the digitization/study batch it captures.

URIs of the register entities this proposition set's assertions are about or derived from (e.g. `digital-representation`/`three-d-model`/`survey-dataset`/`observation` instances it aggregates as evidence for the documented `heritage-object`). Modelled as a flat reference list (crm:P148_has_component) — the deeper process/software/device provenance chain D7.1's worked example shows (D2 Digitization Process, D14 Software, D6 Digital Device, D9 Data Object) is not modelled here; see `description.md`.

URI of the `event` instance (co-typed hdto:HC11_Digital_Twin_Maintenance) that added this proposition set (HP30 added content, inverse direction — HP30i). Required: every proposition set exists because some maintenance activity produced it.
URI of the `heritage-proposition-set` this one supersedes within the same digital twin's version chain (HP32 replaced).
